title: smma: Source Mixture Matching Analysis for receptor-model factors
description:
smma is an R package for interpreting receptor-model factors (for example from EPA PMF 5.0) with an external library of measured source profiles. Each factor profile is fitted as a non-negative mixture of library sources by weighted non-negative least squares; analyte bootstrap resampling gives fit-quality-weighted uncertainty, and the source weights are propagated back to samples for any grouping of analytes. The package also provides profile-distance metrics, PAC diagnostic ratios and alkylation indices, library sensitivity tools, distance-based site classification and spatial distance-decay regressions.

The repository includes scripts and data that reproduce the source apportionment of polycyclic aromatic compounds and petroleum biomarkers in British Columbia intertidal sediments (Pelletier et al., submitted to Environmental Pollution).
